guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 本課以濕井、格柵、泵曲線與堵塞預兆為主線，從來水與纖維物辨識、格柵有效通水面積、壓力管流速情境、濕井庫存與停留進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
guides.conceptEn: This course develops wet wells, screens, pump curves and clogging precursors through ten connected units, beginning with influent and fibrous-material mapping, effective screen flow area, force-main velocity scenarios, wet-well inventory and residence. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

evidence: 在離線工作台先選取「來水與纖維物辨識」的觀測點。用離線剖面圖標示纖維纏繞與剩餘通道。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「格柵有效通水面積」的觀測點。用離線剖面圖標示纖維纏繞與剩餘通道。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「壓力管流速情境」的觀測點。由流量與實際內徑計算，配合沉積與纖維觀察。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「濕井庫存與停留」的觀測點。對照水位訊號與儲槽幾何，分列高水位警報裕量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「揚程與輸送功率」的觀測點。同步量流量、壓差、功率，避免用銘牌功率代替實測。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「基線與堵塞前兆」的觀測點。把流量、吸排壓、轉速、電流與振動放在同一時間軸。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「並聯與備援能力」的觀測點。在模型上停用一台，檢查電源與止回閥是否為共同失效點。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「清理與機械隔離」的觀測點。把流量、吸排壓、轉速、電流與振動放在同一時間軸。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「雨峰與故障重播」的觀測點。比較分鐘流量序列與每日累積水量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「全生命週期成效」的觀測點。同步讀取電表、流量計與水質趨勢。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
evidenceEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for influent and fibrous-material mapping. Mark fiber entanglement and remaining passages on an offline section drawing. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for effective screen flow area. Mark fiber entanglement and remaining passages on an offline section drawing. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for force-main velocity scenarios. Calculate from flow and actual diameter and compare with deposits/fibers. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for wet-well inventory and residence. Compare level signals with wet-well geometry and separate high-level alarm margin. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for head and pumping power. Measure flow, pressure rise and power simultaneously instead of using nameplate power. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for baseline and clogging precursors. Place flow, suction/discharge pressure, speed, current and vibration on one timeline. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for parallel operation and redundancy. Disable one pump in the model and check common power/check-valve failures. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for cleaning and mechanical isolation. Place flow, suction/discharge pressure, speed, current and vibration on one timeline. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for storm-peak and failure replay. Compare minute-scale flow with daily total volume. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for lifecycle performance evidence. Synchronize electricity, flow and water-quality trends. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
pitfalls: 只記堵塞次數而不記堵塞物種類與位置。診斷與介入：以遠端影像與前後水位確認遮蔽，依維護程序處理。
纖維薄層遮住網孔卻被視為無大物體。診斷與介入：以遠端影像與前後水位確認遮蔽，依維護程序處理。
平均速度足夠卻忽略彎頭局部掛料。診斷與介入：核對實際管徑及流量，查彎頭、纖維與沉積證據。
使用總井深而非可用容積估時間。診斷與介入：用可用容積與進出流量重算，另看高水位及備援限制。
把電流下降誤判為節能成功。診斷與介入：配對流量、揚程、轉速與電表，再比較工作點。
不同雨天與旱天工作點直接比較。診斷與介入：以相同揚程轉速重新比較，讓合格人員依隔離程序檢查。
把每台銘牌流量相加當實際並聯流量。診斷與介入：以共同系統曲線驗證並聯情境，不能只加總銘牌。
把畫面停機當作所有能量已隔離。診斷與介入：以相同揚程轉速重新比較，讓合格人員依隔離程序檢查。
同時更動所有輸入而無法辨識失效原因。診斷與介入：用實際峰值歷線重播，查瞬時水位及下游能力。
節省電力但溢流與維護工時增加。診斷與介入：配對相同流量與出水品質再比較能耗，列出附屬設備。
pitfallsEn: Only event counts are recorded, without material type or location. Diagnostic response: Verify obstruction using remote images/level difference and follow maintenance procedures.
A thin fiber mat covers openings but is dismissed because no large object is visible. Diagnostic response: Verify obstruction using remote images/level difference and follow maintenance procedures.
Adequate mean velocity hides snagging at fittings. Diagnostic response: Check actual diameter/flow and inspect fittings, fibers and deposits.
Total depth replaces usable storage in the time estimate. Diagnostic response: Recalculate usable volume/inflow/outflow and separately assess high-level/redundancy limits.
Lower current is misread as successful energy savings. Diagnostic response: Match flow, head, speed and electricity before comparing duty points.
Wet- and dry-weather duty points are compared without normalization. Diagnostic response: Compare at matched head/speed and have qualified staff inspect under isolation procedures.
Nameplate flows are added as if they were actual parallel output. Diagnostic response: Verify parallel scenarios against the shared system curve, not summed nameplates.
A stopped screen display is mistaken for complete energy isolation. Diagnostic response: Compare at matched head/speed and have qualified staff inspect under isolation procedures.
Changing all inputs together prevents fault attribution. Diagnostic response: Replay actual peak hydrographs and check instantaneous levels/downstream capacity.
Electricity falls while overflows and maintenance hours rise. Diagnostic response: Compare energy at matched flow/quality and list auxiliary equipment.

history.title: 污水泵站堵塞預防
history.titleEn: Clogging prevention in sewage pump stations
history.text: 本課以公開技術手冊建立方法背景；來源出版年代不代表此程序首次發明的年代。舊版文件僅提供原理與歷史脈絡，現場工作仍須確認當地現行規定與設備文件。
history.textEn: Public technical manuals establish the methodological background; publication dates do not identify the invention date. Older documents provide principles and historical context, while real work still requires current local requirements and equipment documentation.

courses.connection: 本課以濕井、格柵、泵曲線與堵塞預兆為主線，從來水與纖維物辨識、格柵有效通水面積、壓力管流速情境、濕井庫存與停留進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
courses.connectionEn: This course develops wet wells, screens, pump curves and clogging precursors through ten connected units, beginning with influent and fibrous-material mapping, effective screen flow area, force-main velocity scenarios, wet-well inventory and residence. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.
